*   **When to Use:** Scenes with a large number of objects, complex curved surfaces (e.g., fractals, high-order surfaces), or when mixing synthetic objects with sampled data (e.g., medical visualization) [S1, unofficial][S2, book].

Both sources state that volume graphics is suitable for rendering fractals and high-order curved surfaces (complex curved surfaces). Both sources also explicitly mention the use case of mixing synthetic geometric objects (like scalpels or prosthetics) with sampled data (such as medical imaging data) within the voxel buffer.
